title: Predicting perinatal mortality based on maternal health status and health insurance service using homogeneous ensemble machine learning methods
summary: The study reports prediction from maternal and infant health records using the evaluated homogeneous ensemble methods. The prediction result does not establish prospective clinical benefit, transportability to other health systems or reduced perinatal mortality.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine-learning models use maternal and infant health variables to predict perinatal mortality.
